Composition studio — pick by letter

One cheese, one content set, six compositions. Everything is now painted from the real Brand Kit: the actual Monti Trentini logo, the spotted cow lifted from that logo, Heritage Cream (#FFFBDC) as the ground, and Cora + Futura PT loaded from Adobe Fonts instead of the Fraunces/Inter fallbacks the app has been running on.

Every knob, and where it is set today

KnobRight nowAlternatives on the table
GroundHeritage Cream #FFFBDCCasa Paper #FAF9F5 · plain white · Alpine Mint tint
Top edgeItalia Green rule, 0.05″Forest Green rule · no rule · full green cap (B)
Logo1.02″ top-centresmall in the footer (B, E) · badge over the photo (C) · none
Cheese nameCora italic bold, 15–16.5 ptroman not italic · all-caps · bigger (retail reads at 6 ft)
Italian nameFutura PT, uppercase, trackeditalic sentence case · drop it entirely
Photo1.0″ band, product trimmed to fillhero to the top edge (C) · oval medallion (D) · round thumb (F) · none
Photo groundwhite, as the packshots were shotknock the white out so the wheel floats on cream · tint to cream
Spec railhorizontal 3-up under the namevertical left rail (E) · two rows · split top/bottom
Cowthe logo’s own Holstein, outlinedoutline only · add “100% Italian milk” · sheep + goat variants for the wider line
Region icondrawn peaks, one per regionMonti’s own photo cutouts · the logo’s “M” mountain glyph
Ageaccent italic numeral + labelboxed badge · “AGED 9 MONTHS” in caps · wheel-and-calendar glyph
DOP markhouse stand-in badgeofficial EU PDO + consortium artwork — still needed
Origintricolore + PRODUCT OF ITALYadd “Trentino, Italy” · drop the tricolore · move beside the QR
QR0.6″, bottom right, captionedbigger · bottom left · no caption · framed in a green chip
Flavor lineabove the rail (B, C, D, F)below the rail (A) · drop it and let the description carry it
Worth knowinglong mode + F onlyon every face · never · replace with a pairing line

Type note: this page asks for Cora and Futura PT from Adobe Fonts kit sac6xdz. If they fail to load, what you are seeing is Fraunces + Inter — the fallbacks the whole CST app has been running on.
